definitions.explanation: The act of adjusting or fine-tuning something to achieve the right level, amount, or condition. Used for physical settings like temperature or brightness, as well as abstract adjustments like scheduling.

examples.japanese: {温度|おんど}を{調節|ちょうせつ}する。
エアコンで{室温|しつおん}を{調節|ちょうせつ}している。
examples.english: I'm regulating the room temperature with the air conditioner.

examples.japanese: {椅子|いす}の{高|たか}さを{自分|じぶん}の{体|からだ}に{合|あ}うように{調節|ちょうせつ}した。
examples.english: I adjusted the height of the chair to fit my body.

notes:
USAGE:
Used broadly for adjusting physical settings, quantities, or conditions to an appropriate level. Unlike {調整|ちょうせい}, which implies bringing something into proper alignment or coordination, {調節|ちょうせつ} focuses on controlling a variable to the desired degree.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {温度|おんど}{調節|ちょうせつ} (temperature regulation)
- {光量|こうりょう}の{調節|ちょうせつ} (light adjustment)
- {体温|たいおん}を{調節|ちょうせつ}する (regulate body temperature)
- {速度|そくど}を{調節|ちょうせつ}する (adjust speed)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {調整|ちょうせい}: adjustment — implies coordinating or fine-tuning to bring into balance, often used for schedules, systems, or interpersonal coordination
- {制御|せいぎょ}: control — stronger, more technical term for managing or governing a system
